title: Medical Document Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting structured information from a medical document, focusing on administrative details, personnel, and patient report data.

fax_transmission_details.title: Fax Transmission Details
fax_transmission_details.description: Information related to the fax transmission itself.

transmission_datetime.title: Transmission Date and Time
transmission_datetime.description: The date and time the fax was transmitted, including timezone offset.

sender_system.title: Sender System
sender_system.description: The system or service used to send the fax.

sender_information.title: Organization Contact Information
sender_information.description: General contact details for the organization sending the fax.

oragnization.title: Organization Name
oragnization.description: The name of the organization sending the fax.

address.title: Organization Address
address.description: The physical address of the organization.

phone_number.title: Organization Phone Number
phone_number.description: The main phone number for the organization.

fax_number.title: Organization Fax Number
fax_number.description: The main fax number for the organization.

website.title: Organization Website
website.description: The website URL for the organization.

patient_report.title: Patient Report Details
patient_report.description: Extracted information from the patient's medical report section.

patient_name.title: Patient Name
patient_name.description: The full name of the patient.

medical_record_number.title: Medical Record Number (MRN)
medical_record_number.description: The patient's unique medical record number.

referring_doctor.title: Referring Doctor
referring_doctor.description: The name and credentials of the referring physician.

study_details.title: Medical Study Details
study_details.description: Details pertaining to the medical study or examination.

accession_number.title: Accession Number
accession_number.description: The unique identifier for the medical study.

study_date.title: Study Date
study_date.description: The date the medical study was performed.

exam_description.title: Exam Description
exam_description.description: A description of the examination performed.

history.title: Patient History
history.description: Relevant patient medical history for the study.

comparison.title: Comparison Studies
comparison.description: Details of previous studies used for comparison.

report_findings.title: Report Findings and Impression
report_findings.description: The technical findings and overall impression from the medical report.

technique.title: Technique Used
technique.description: Description of the imaging or examination technique.

findings.title: Detailed Findings
findings.description: The detailed observations and findings from the examination.

impression.title: Impression
impression.description: The summary conclusion or diagnosis based on the findings.

dictated_by.title: Dictated By
dictated_by.description: The name and credentials of the person who dictated the report.

signed_by.title: Electronically Signed By
signed_by.description: The name, credentials, and timestamp of the electronic signature.
